about_title: One page, one lesson, one family at a time.
about_intro: Wings of Tawakkul is a small Islamic bookstore in Singapore, sharing beneficial books and learning resources with Muslim families.
about_body:
## Why we began

Wings of Tawakkul was established with a simple hope: to make beneficial Islamic knowledge more accessible to families. As parents and learners ourselves, we know how hard it can be to find books that are sound in content, beautiful to hold and simple enough to use at home on an ordinary evening.

So we began gathering them: books that teach children to love Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, to reflect on the Qur'an, and to carry good adab into everyday life. Alongside them we create printable resources for the small, practical moments of learning that happen at the kitchen table.

## Our name

Tawakkul is trust in Allah. The Prophet ﷺ described the birds who leave their nests each morning hungry and return in the evening full. They do not stay still; they go out, they make the effort, and they trust Allah for the result.

That is how we try to work. We choose carefully, we teach sincerely, and we leave the outcome with Allah.

about_values.title: Sound content
about_values.text: Books grounded in the Qur'an and Sunnah, written with care and respect for the deen.

about_values.title: Made for home
about_values.text: Short lessons and stories a parent can share in a few minutes, without needing to be a teacher.

about_values.title: A love for reading
about_values.text: Pages children want to return to, so that learning feels like a gift and not a chore.

about_closing:
## Our commitment

We are an authorised reseller of the Quranic Tarbiyah series, and we are proud to share titles from Umm Assad Publications. We only stock books we would be happy to read with our own children.

If you ever have a question about a book, a level or what might suit your child, please write to us. We would love to help.

faq.question: Which Quranic Tarbiyah level should I choose?
faq.answer: Each level matches one year of age: Level 1 for age 5, Level 2 for age 6, Level 3 for age 7, Level 4 for age 8 and Level 5 for age 9. If your child is reading ahead or needs more time, message us and we will help you choose.

faq.question: How do I place an order?
faq.answer: Tap Buy now on any book or printable. You check out securely on Payhip, our shop partner, and receive an email receipt.

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: Checkout on Payhip accepts Visa, Mastercard and PayPal.

faq.question: How do I receive printables?
faq.answer: You can download your PDF right after checkout, and the download link is emailed to you too. Please check your spam folder if you don't see it.

faq.question: Do you deliver outside Singapore?
faq.answer: At the moment we post within Singapore only. Printables can be bought from anywhere.

faq.question: Can I reserve a book that is coming soon?
faq.answer: Yes. Message us on Instagram with the title and we will let you know as soon as it arrives.

shipping:
## Delivery within Singapore

We post books with local mailing services within Singapore. Postage is shown at checkout on Payhip, and we send your parcel after your order comes through.

## Digital printables

Printables are available to download immediately after checkout, and the link is emailed to you. Nothing is posted.

## Damaged or incorrect items

If a book arrives damaged or you received the wrong title, please message us within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we will make it right.

## Returns

Because our stock is limited, we are not able to accept returns for change of mind. Digital products cannot be returned once the download link has been sent.
privacy:
We respect your privacy and collect only what we need to fulfil your order.

## What we collect

When you order, our shop partner Payhip shares with us your name, email address and, for books, your delivery address.

## How we use it

We use these details only to process and deliver your order and to reply to your questions. We do not sell or share your information with anyone except the mailing service that delivers your parcel.

## Payments

Payments are processed by Payhip and its payment providers (Stripe and PayPal). We never see or store your card details.

## Your rights

You can ask us at any time to see or delete the information we hold about you, in line with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
